authority: owner card-improvement specification 2026-08-19, following the 8/18 settlement lesson: 'model closer to 50% than the market' is not automatically sharp — the largest MLB dog gaps were compression artifacts.
applies_from: the next card built after this commit; existing registered cards are NOT restated

1_THREE_STATEMENTS_PER_ROW.WINNER: who the model expects to win (probability + predicted winner)
1_THREE_STATEMENTS_PER_ROW.PRICE: which moneyline offers value, if any, under the uncertainty-adjusted screen
1_THREE_STATEMENTS_PER_ROW.ATS: which team should cover the registered spread
1_THREE_STATEMENTS_PER_ROW.principle: a predicted loser can be the moneyline or ATS value side; the WNBA 1-3 winners / 3-1 spread-overlay night is the canonical example and neither table was wrong

2_COMPRESSION_CONFLICT_GATE_FROZEN.definition: market_confidence - model_confidence >= 0.05, where confidence = |p - 0.5| and market p is same-book de-vigged
2_COMPRESSION_CONFLICT_GATE_FROZEN.label: COMPRESSION_CONFLICT — AUDIT_REQUIRED
2_COMPRESSION_CONFLICT_GATE_FROZEN.consequence: the row stays visible with all numbers, but can NEVER be classified PAPER_EDGE until (a) personnel are complete AND (b) the edge class has forward validation
2_COMPRESSION_CONFLICT_GATE_FROZEN.evidence_basis: claimed edges >=5pp are 0-6 lifetime across the two settled priced slates

3_UNCERTAINTY_ADJUSTED_EDGE_FROZEN.screen: lower confidence bound of p_model > p_break_even (never the point estimate alone)
3_UNCERTAINTY_ADJUSTED_EDGE_FROZEN.lcb_mlb: p - 1.96*sqrt(p(1-p)/30000) — the Monte-Carlo SE of the frozen sim. DISCLOSED UNDERSTATEMENT: this quantifies simulation noise only, not model error, which two settled slates show is far larger (market beats V13 by ~0.04 Brier). Therefore even a passing LCB screen cannot mint QUALIFIED_PAPER_EDGE while the edge class lacks forward validation.
3_UNCERTAINTY_ADJUSTED_EDGE_FROZEN.lcb_wnba: NOT COMPUTABLE — the shadow logistic carries no frozen per-game uncertainty. Uncertainty status NOT_QUANTIFIED; any positive raw edge caps at PRICE_SENSITIVE.

4_ATS_AND_TOTALS_PROBABILITIES.mlb: cover/push/fail probabilities at the REGISTERED spread and over/push/under at the registered total, computed from the verified byte-identical sim replay's margin and total distributions (card_render discipline: refuse unless the replay reproduces the registered card). With juice these yield break-even and EV.
4_ATS_AND_TOTALS_PROBABILITIES.wnba: no distribution exists — margin-minus-spread is a DIRECTIONAL_DIAGNOSTIC and is labelled exactly that, even though the frozen ATS cohort grades it
4_ATS_AND_TOTALS_PROBABILITIES.totals_reporting_everywhere: MAE, MEDIAN absolute error, signed bias, and LARGEST MISS — cancellation concealed WNBA errors and SEA@MIL 22-0 dominated MLB MAE; a mean alone is banned

5_ONE_IMMUTABLE_ROW.store: data/cards_unified/{date}_{sport}.jsonl — one pregame record per game with row_id, forecast_id, winner_selection_id, ats_selection_id, total_selection_id, registered line/juice/book/capture timestamp, model probability/margin/total, all flags
5_ONE_IMMUTABLE_ROW.settlement: appends a type=settlement line bearing the SAME row_id to the SAME file; the pregame line is never edited and no separate results table is ever recreated

6_PERSONNEL_INTEGRITY_FIELDS: lineup_state (NONE_AVAILABLE until a lineup rail exists)
sort_rationale: ranking by raw model-market gap placed the least trustworthy rows first on 8/18

trust_ladder_frozen.BLOCKED: no registered price, or slate/eligibility failure
trust_ladder_frozen.PERSONNEL_INCOMPLETE: a TBD/CAP starter or unresolved personnel on either side (subordinates any positive edge)
trust_ladder_frozen.COMPRESSION_CONFLICT: the frozen gate above (subordinates any positive edge)
trust_ladder_frozen.PRICE_SENSITIVE: 0 < conservative edge < 2pp, or uncertainty NOT_QUANTIFIED with positive raw edge
trust_ladder_frozen.QUALIFIED_PAPER_EDGE: conservative edge >= 2pp AND no compression conflict AND personnel complete AND the edge class is forward-validated. CURRENTLY EMPTY BY CONSTRUCTION: no edge class has forward validation (>=5pp class is 0-6). The card prints this emptiness rather than relaxing the bar.

MODEL_LESSONS_RECORDED.mlb_binding_problem: discrimination, still: v3 .2402 vs market .2044 Brier despite better starter information
MODEL_LESSONS_RECORDED.starter_vs_form: starter resolution matters more than form freshness, but starter features alone did not validate V14
MODEL_LESSONS_RECORDED.explicitly_deprioritized: more unshrunk recent form; another estimator swap
MODEL_LESSONS_RECORDED.wnba_margin_head: may be more useful than the winner-probability mapping — requires a PREREGISTERED coherence/margin-to-win investigation before any use; named as a pending prereg, NOT run, NOT promoted from a 3-1 night
MODEL_LESSONS_RECORDED.market_position: essential downstream evaluation evidence; FORBIDDEN in the predictive feature path, unchanged
